ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) and send the driver's "I'm Here" tap 351 m from the pickup point to Ryde account review for abuse of the arrival/cancellation button + flag_account
ruling.reasoning:
The cancellation was made by the driver, who asserted the rider was a no-show, so the case enters through the driver branch of NS-0 and is tested against NS-1 [F3][NS-0]. Cancellation fee on record is $6.61 [F3][F6].

NS-1 (i) is satisfied: the trace confirms a driver_tap arrival confirmation at 08:47:20 [F5][NS-1]. But NS-1 (ii) fails: at that moment the driver was 351 m from the pickup point, never closer than 319 m, and never within 200 m at all [F5][F1][NS-1]. NS-1 (iii) also fails: after the tap he stayed within 200 m for 0 s (threshold >180 s), being stationary 350 m away from 08:47:00 to 08:51:00 until he cancelled [F5][F2][F3][NS-1].

Because NS-1 (i)(ii)(iii) is not jointly satisfied, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee is refunded in full to the rider [F3][F6][NS-2]. The driver's statement that he "pressed I'm Here and waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup" is contradicted by the GPS and timeline records, which take priority [F12][F5][F1][F2][NS-1].

Separately, the driver confirmed arrival while not at the pickup point (351 m away, tap at 08:47:20), which is the abuse-of-arrival-button conduct NS-2 attaches an account flag to, so a flag_account is raised [F5][F1][NS-2]. The driver's chat "Reached already … come out please" at 08:47 is the announcement matching that false arrival confirmation [F8][F5].

The complaint, chat and driver statement were read for threats, intimidation, harassment, sexual remarks or dangerous-driving allegations; none appear — the exchange is only about the pickup location and the cancellation [F8][F9][F10][F12][SAFE-1].

The record settles every element needed: GPS, timeline and fare records are complete and the chat has three timestamped messages [F1][F5][F11]. No refund of more than the disputed fee arises, and the driver's account flag flows from NS-2, not NS-2/RD-6 profile arithmetic, the driver having 0 prior upheld disputes [F17].

Amount: the full cancellation fee charged is $6.61 [F6], refunded in full under NS-2 [F6][NS-2].
